password_reset_request_system.description: Users cannot change passwords themselves. They submit a request with username + clock number, and admin/manager receives notification to reset it.

user_flow: User clicks 'Forgot Password?' on login page
User enters username and clock number
User sees message to contact manager/admin
User receives notification on dashboard after admin processes request
admin_flow: Admin/Manager sees notification icon (bell) with red badge count in navbar
Admin clicks Notifications to view all pending requests
Admin can either Reset Password (redirects to edit user) or Reject request
After password reset, request is marked as 'approved' and user is notified
notification_system: Notification icon in navbar with animated red badge
Badge shows count of pending password reset requests
Context processor adds pending_reset_count to all templates

stock_usage_tracking_system.feature: Stock Usage Tracking with Signal-Based Automatic Deletion
stock_usage_tracking_system.description: Allows users to log stock usage and request deletion even when supervisors are not around. Uses Django signals to automatically process approved requests and delete/reduce stock quantities.

user_flow: User navigates to 'Track Usage' page from navigation menu
User enters clock number (must match account)
User selects kit type and quantity used
User optionally adds purpose and feedback about stock quality
System creates StockUsage record with status='pending'
User can view their usage history and track status
admin_flow: Admin sees notification badge on 'Track Usage' menu link
Admin sees alert box on tracking page with pending count
Admin clicks 'Review Pending' to see all pending requests
Admin reviews request details including user feedback
Admin approves or rejects with optional admin notes
Upon approval, signal automatically deletes/reduces stock
Admin can view complete history with filters
signal_processing: handle_stock_usage_approval - Fires when status changes to 'approved'
Automatically deletes kit if quantity matches usage
Automatically reduces kit quantity if partial usage
Logs all actions to django.log with detailed information
log_kit_deletion - Maintains audit trail when kits are deleted
notify_on_stock_usage - Logs new usage requests and feedback
